Game Overview

In Galaxy Fighter, the core idea is straightforward: take control of your fighter plane in Galaxy Fighter, a thrilling space shoot-'em-up where agility and precision reign supreme. Navigate through galactic dangers, dodge enemy fire, and collect crucial power-ups to enhance your ship. Rack up points and battle for the top spot on the leaderboard in this high-octane adventure.
